role: Draws the HRV report's header, summary hero (RMSSD + badge rated against the user's canonical baseline, or age/sex norms before one exists + readiness gauge + HR stats), the shared compact stat-box row, metric grids (time/frequency/nonlinear/ANS/quality), analysis-window card, page footer with wellness disclaimer, auto-pagination, and the recovery score breakdown with its measured height.
types: ReportSectionRenderer.HeroHRVRating: struct — the hero's RMSSD category and its optional age phrase
toplevel: Private static lets compositeBadgeHeight (28) and factorRowHeight (38). File-scope private helpers are listed as units.

units.does: Draws the header block from the top margin: brand+subtitle, session date/recording line, optional age/sex line; returns y below it.
Draws a 4×44pt primary accent bar and 'Emuqu' in the title font, then the subtitle.
Draws the localized 'Recovery Report' subtitle under the brand and returns y+50.
Draws the session info line (date and recording length / summary-import note) and returns y+18.
Draws 'Age: n  •  Sex: x' in caption grey when either is set (+16), then adds 14pt spacing (two consecutive += 7).

branches.effect: draws the line and advances 16; empty → skips the line

units.does: Reads user settings and returns localized 'Age: n' when age is set and 'Sex: x' when biological sex is set and not .other.
calls: closure:settingsProvider — PDFReportGenerator.init default reads AppDependencies.current.app.settingsManager.settingsSnapshot; tests inject UserSettings()

units.does: Rates tonight's RMSSD once (heroHRVRating against baselineRMSSD), draws the summary hero with that rating and then the HR stats row; returns y below.

Fills a 90pt grey rounded hero box, draws the big RMSSD value in the rating's colour and the assessment (badge + optional age phrase), and a readiness gauge on the right using composite score/10 or else ANS readiness; returns y+100.
Draws the 48pt RMSSD value in the given colour and 'ms' after it, kept left-to-right on a mirrored page.
Draws the 'HRV (RMSSD)' caption, the assessment badge for the rating's category, and — for a population (age/sex) rating only — the age-context phrase 8pt after the badge's drawn right edge.

branches.cond: rating has an age phrase (no personal baseline)
branches.effect: draws it after the badge; otherwise nothing more

units.does: x of the badge: margin + max(85, caption width + 28) so a long translated caption is not overlapped.
Draws the category's localized label in a 9pt semibold pill tinted with hrvCategoryColor at heroBadgeX; returns the pill's right edge.
Draws the age-context phrase in 8pt grey at the given x, level with the badge.

Fills a 50pt stats row and draws four boxes (Min HR, Avg HR, Max HR in bpm, SDNN in ms, from the analysis window; min/max HR and SDNN marked '(estimate)' when the result holds them as estimates) through drawStatBoxRow, 38pt tall at y+6; returns y+65.

Draws one row of compact stat boxes, column i at margin + i*boxWidth inset 4pt, boxHeight tall; items with an empty title leave their column blank. Shared by the summary HR row and PDFReportGenerator's sleep/training/vitals rows.

branches.cond: for each item where title non-empty
branches.effect: draws a box; empty-title items skipped

units.does: Draws the readiness gauge: arcs, score text and 'Recovery' label.
Saves state, strokes the grey track and the coloured sweep, restores state.
Strokes an 8pt round-capped arc from 135° spanning 270°×score/10 in the readiness colour (score is not clamped to 0–10).
Draws the score (1 decimal, 18pt, readiness colour) centred and '/10' below.
Draws a 7pt grey title and a 13pt bold coloured value in the rect.
Maps settings biological sex to AgeAdjustedHRV.Sex and returns AgeAdjustedHRV.interpret(rmssd, age, sex).

Rates RMSSD for the hero: with a positive baselineRMSSD, AnalysisSummaryGenerator.personalCategory(ratio: rmssd/baseline) and no age phrase (as the report's summary and Today rate it); otherwise the age/sex-adjusted category and its localized age phrase.
Colour for an RMSSD category: excellent secondary green, good green at 0.8 alpha, fair amber, reduced orange, low accent red.
Gauge colour by 0–10 readiness on RecoveryScoreConstants.ReadinessLabels (ready 7.0 → green, moderate 4.5 → amber, fatigued 2.0 → red accent, else dusty rose).
Draws 'Time Domain HRV' heading and the timeDomainGridMetrics grid for the result; returns y+8.

flags.text: ARCHITECTURE.md and USERS_MANUAL.md list the full metric grids (time, frequency, nonlinear, ANS) as page-1 content of every report, but drawDetailedMetricTables (which calls these grid sections) runs only for style == .comprehensive with .deepDive selected, so Summary and Sleep presets have no metric grids.

units.does: Draws 'Frequency Domain HRV' heading and the frequency metric grid; returns y+8.
Draws 'Nonlinear HRV' heading and the nonlinear grid for the result; returns y+8.
Draws 'ANS Indexes' heading and the ANS grid; returns y+8.
Draws 'Data Quality' heading, the quality grid and the analysis-window caveat; returns y+30.
Draws the caption note that metrics come from a short selected window, not the full recording.
Draws 'Analysis Window' heading and a 70pt card with time range, window HR/stability and selection reason; returns y+80.
Fills the grey rounded card background.
When both window start/end ms exist, draws 'Time Range: m:ss – m:ss (duration)' (offsets into the recording) and advances 16.

branches.effect: draws the line, y+16; else nothing

units.does: Draws window mean HR then stability on one line; returns y+16.
Draws 'Window HR: n bpm' when present and shifts x by 100.

branches.effect: draws and returns x+100; nil → returns x unchanged

units.does: Draws 'Stability: <label> (CV: x.xx)' coloured by CV when stability exists.
Draws the localized window-selection reason, wrapped into a 24pt box, when non-empty.
Formats ms as h:mm:ss when ≥1 h else m:ss.
Formats a ms duration via PDFDurationText.minutesSeconds (seconds clamped into Int).
Localized stability label by coefficient of variation.
Stability colour by CV.
Draws the centred page footer line and the wellness disclaimer below it.
Draws centred 'Emuqu • Page n • <now, medium date short time>' 15pt below the bottom margin line; returns its size.
Draws the 'wellness and fitness use only; not a medical device' disclaimer under the footer, full content width.
Pagination: if y+needed exceeds pageHeight−bottomMargin−20, draws the footer, increments the page number, begins a new (RTL-mirrored if needed) page and returns the top margin; else returns y.

branches.effect: footer + new page, returns margins.top; false → returns y unchanged

units.does: Colour for a factor's impact: positive green, neutral yellow, negative red.

Draws 'Recovery Score Breakdown' heading, composite badge, verdict message, one bar per factor, vitals penalties and the weighted-average note; returns y below. Draws no page break itself: its caller reserves scoreBreakdownHeight first.
Fills a 28pt badge tinted by diagnosticColorForScore(composite) — the ScoreVerdict ladder colour the app uses — and draws score and tier labels; returns the same y (caller adds the badge height).
Draws the composite score (0 decimals, 16pt mono) and 'Tier n' caption inside the badge.
Draws the ScoreBreakdownCopy verdict message (with the advice gate's load level), laid out by compositeMessageLayout, wrapped across the content width under the badge; returns y after it +8.
The verdict message from ScoreBreakdownCopy.message(for:loadLevel:), its 9pt dark-grey attributes, and its wrapped height (ceil) at contentWidth-16.

Height drawScoreBreakdownSection advances for this breakdown: heading 20 + badge 28 + 4 + message height + 8 + (factorRowHeight+4) per factor + penalties block (18 + 12 per penalty + 28, when any) + math line 14 (when showsWeightedAverageNote) + 8. Used by the caller to start a new page first.
Draws a row per factor, advancing 42pt each.

branches.effect: draws one row; no factors → y unchanged

units.does: Draws a factor row: grey background, impact dot, localized factor label (stored English key looked up in the app bundle), score×weight, progress bar and detail.
Draws right-aligned '<score> × <weight>%' kept left-to-right on mirrored pages.
Draws a grey 4pt track and a fill proportional to min(score,100)/100 in the impact colour, then the detail line.
Draws the factor's display detail (with the user's temperature unit) in 7.5pt, truncated to a 10pt-high rect inside the row.
When penalties exist, draws 'Vitals Penalties Applied:' and one '⚠ <penalty>' line per display penalty, then the explanation; returns y+28 past them.

branches.effect: returns y unchanged; else draws block

units.does: Draws a 7.5pt wrapped explanation that penalties are deducted after the weighted composite.
True when penalties applied and the composite is more than a point under the weighted factor average (breakdown.gapFromFactors > 1) — the condition ScoreBreakdownCopy's penalty message uses.
When showsWeightedAverageNote: draws 'Weighted average: (composite + gap) − Vitals: gap = Final: composite' using breakdown.gapFromFactors; returns y+8 (+14 more when drawn).

branches.effect: draws the math line (+14); else nothing

flags.text: The math line labels the whole gap below the weighted average 'Vitals' whenever any penalty applied, though the gap can also hold baseline drift and the penalties can include non-vitals ones; penalties are stored as strings without amounts, so the split cannot be shown (ScoreBreakdownCopy.vitalsPenaltyMessage attributes the gap the same way).

units.does: Builds the header info line: 'Date: <end-or-start date>  •  Recording: x.x min (n beats)' when the series has beats, else '… Summary import (no raw beat data)'.

branches.effect: durationMinutes 0 — unreachable since totalBeats>0 implies a series

units.does: Strokes the 8pt light-grey 270° gauge track from 135° to 405°.
Draws the 7pt 'Recovery' label below the gauge.
Frequency grid rows: VLF (if present), LF, HF, LF/HF (if present), Total, LF/HF n.u. (if both present).
Time-domain grid rows: Mean NN, SDNN, RMSSD, pNN50, Mean HR, SDSD (SDNN, pNN50 and SDSD marked '(estimate)' when the result holds them as estimates) and the HRV triangular index when present.
Nonlinear grid rows: SD1, SD2, SD1/SD2 always (each marked '(estimate)' when the result holds it as one); ApEn, SampEn, DFA α1, α2 when present.
ANS grid rows: Stress Index, PNS, SNS, HRV Readiness (/10), Resp Rate, each only when present.
Quality grid rows: recorded beats, analysis-window minutes ('—' when unknown/0), window clean beats ('—' when unknown), artifact %.
